tests.scope: V19-V25 geometry/color, identity evidence and OCR mocks, automatic ROI/anchor guards, Korean paired assets, copy counts, data integrity/audit/export, one-start Tk workflow, split workers, mocked HTTP; no physical camera or live server

initial_capture_retry_identity: Same frame, camera, serial, epoch, source, ROI context, batch and session; changed pixels rejected
config_check_stdout: V25 config/layouts/camera settings OK: A=12 B=16 C=12 D=64. Hardware/models not opened.
migration: Select the existing dataset root; no raw/manifest/ROI/prediction/pose bulk migration.
New captures use stable per-frame identities; existing explicit image IDs remain unchanged.
Reviewed exports are now one reviewed-ID directory. JSONL raw_path resolves from that directory; source_raw_path preserves original provenance.
Automatic exports add EXPORT_STATUS.json in addition to the export receipt. UI data JSON count excludes both auxiliary JSON files.
Training sample metadata includes output sha256; classification directory structure remains unchanged.
limitations: No fully automatic high-quality-only selection; quality metrics are advisory and candidates may be uncertain.
No vehicle-outline model for definitive parking-line violation decisions.
Empty board replay is not real D39 vehicle number/color accuracy; OCR uses historical observations, no new model run.
Stable-ID retries require the same frame/context; no automatic reconstruction after process restart when only orphan raw pixels remain.
SystemExit fault injection is not physical power failure or OneDrive concurrent-write testing.
One writer per dataset; no multiprocess lock, orphan cleanup or global image deduplication.
Export completion verifies bytes at completion, not subsequent external USB/cloud transfers; recipient may recheck listed SHA256 hashes.
No physical camera/GPU/trained model/live server/Geti/long-run or visible UI/DPI inspection this task.
Automatic candidates differ from human ground truth; complete files do not establish recognition accuracy.
